gameName: The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game
firstPlayerRule: Choose a first player and give them the first-player token. If the group cannot decide, select the first player randomly.
clarifications: The first player gets the first opportunity to play cards during Planning, followed by the other players clockwise.
Pass the first-player token clockwise during the Refresh phase.
